title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Grant Handoff
objective: Define the governed approval application authority grant handoff contract before any live authority handoff can be considered, while keeping grant handoff, grants, approval application, DB/runtime writes, execution, provider calls, project mutation, deploy, package, network, and spend blocked.
safetyRules: Do not enable approval application authority grant handoff in P125.1.
Do not enable live authority grant, activation, approval application, approval capture, approval persistence, or approve/reject decision recording in P125.1.
Do not enable DB writes, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, runtime writes, runtime execution, or execution unlock in P125.1.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P125.1.
Do not change Command Center source or dashboard tests in P125.1.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/log/policy dumps, raw private IDs, raw DB names, raw report paths in primary UX, fake runnable actions, or mutation controls.
Future P125 subphases must define narrow handoff state, validation, UX, rollback, and explicit operator evidence before any later phase can consider live behavior.
knownLimitations: P125.1 is contract/policy only and does not hand off live authority.
P125.2 is metadata-only and does not hand off live authority.
P125.3 is model-only and does not hand off live authority.
P125.4 is dry-run preview only and does not hand off live authority.
P125.5 is scoped Command Center display-only UX and does not hand off live authority.
P125.6 is validation/docs closure only and does not hand off live authority.
P125.7 is final validation only and does not hand off live authority.

Approval application authority grant handoff, authority grant, activation, approval application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and provider spend remain blocked.
summary: P125.1 creates the implementation-grade grant handoff contract and status handoff only. Live authority handoff remains blocked.
